events.label: OrbitFabric Analytics baseline collection begins
events.notes: Internal observability milestone; not an explanatory external event.

events.label: OrbitFabric F´ Adapter v0.1.0 first stable release
events.notes: First stable public release of the OrbitFabric F´ Adapter, published earlier on the same day as the upstream F´ discussion event.

events.label: OrbitFabric F´ Adapter v0.1.1 release identity correction
events.notes: Same-day patch release correcting release Source Coordinate metadata while preserving the accepted v0.1.0 integration behavior.

events.label: F´ upstream discussion on deployment-resolved identity and COSMOS generation
events.notes: OrbitFabric F´ adapter evidence introduced into the upstream discussion, focusing on generated-dictionary provenance, deployment-resolved identity across native layout refactors, and explicit diagnostics for lossy COSMOS mappings.

events.label: Libre Space contribution on GPSD and PPS station clock discipline
events.notes: Strong technical community contribution by the OrbitFabric maintainer. The contribution is not about OrbitFabric and must not be treated as direct ecosystem outreach; its relevance is indirect through maintainer reputation and possible later ecosystem discovery.

events.label: Libre Space contribution on INSPIRESat-1 telemetry access and bulk frame export
events.notes: Strong technical community contribution by the OrbitFabric maintainer around SatNOGS telemetry access. It is not OrbitFabric-specific; any relation to OrbitFabric traffic is indirect through reputation and possible ecosystem discovery, not direct promotion.

events.label: Libre Space PHASMA discussion on XTCE and C serializer contract alignment
events.notes: Technical discussion around PHASMA as an interoperability case, highlighting the risk of packet-contract drift when XTCE layouts and C serializers evolve as separate representations.
